title: Versatility of the old blues pianists and never finishing learning
summary: Lewis says the old players were popular because they could play anything, not just one blues, and that a musician never stops learning.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out
